subject: Hospitality
title: The Open Kitchen Movement
description: Learn The Open Kitchen Movement in one minute.

hook.text: Open kitchens let diners watch chefs work. What was once hidden backstage became the restaurant's main performance.

buildup.text: The trend started in the 1980s as chefs became celebrities. Seeing the cooking added entertainment value to the dining experience.

discovery.text: Open kitchens also signal transparency. Guests trust what they can see—visible cleanliness and skill build confidence in the food.

twist.text: Open kitchens force higher design standards. Old hidden kitchens could be messy; visible ones must be clean, organized.

climax.text: The chef's counter—seats directly facing the kitchen—commands premium prices. Proximity to the action is itself a luxury product.

punchline.text: Hidden to showcased. The kitchen became a stage and the chef its star.

quiz.question: Why do open kitchens build guest trust?
options: Guests can cook their own food
Visible cleanliness and skill create confidence in the food quality
